issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按单卡 26f 只渲出翻转前的 hold 和第一张卡刚起翻，三连翻和结论数字完全没出现
画面上方打着调试占位标题「CARD FLIP REVEAL」
背面只有一个 Helvetica 800 大数字，缺 md 要求的那行小标签，也看不出它是哪张功能卡的成果
翻转时卡片贴在原地转、阴影跟着面片一起转，没有离桌感；背面 2px 灰边
平灰底色，画面没有光向和层次
changes: 补 CARD_FLIP_REVEAL_DURATION = 145（源码时间轴写明 64–145 三卡静止），翻转 18f+8f、192° 过冲、10f 错峰、侧棱加深高光带全部保持原值
调试标题换成居中的 kicker「Launch results」+ 60px 标题，柔光 Backdrop 主光在正上方
正反面语义成对：正面 Active users / Top pages / Deploys 三张出版级功能卡，背面左上同名小标 + 104px 数字 + 32px 结论标签；标签比数字晚 4f 起、上浮 10px 落定（跟随）
翻转时卡片按 sin 包络离桌放大 5%；地面影子独立于 3D 旋转，宽度跟投影宽度 |cos θ| 收放，接触影随抬起淡出、环境影变大变虚下移 34px
背面改为发丝线 + 顶部内高光 + 微渐变白，系统字体栈 + tabular-nums
issuesEn: No duration constant: the workbench rendered only 26f, i.e. the pre-roll hold and the first card barely starting to turn — the triple flip and result numbers never appeared
A debug placeholder title "CARD FLIP REVEAL" sat at the top of the frame
The back face was a lone Helvetica 800 number, missing the one-line label the md calls for, with no link to which feature it came from
Cards spun in place with the shadow painted onto the rotating face, so there was no lift off the table; the back face had a 2px grey border
Flat grey background with no light direction or depth
changesEn: Added CARD_FLIP_REVEAL_DURATION = 145 (the source timeline states 64–145 is the all-settled hold); 18f+8f flip, 192° overshoot, 10f stagger and the edge-darkening sheen keep their original values
Replaced the debug title with a centred "Launch results" kicker and a 60px headline over a soft Backdrop lit from directly above

Faces now pair semantically: fronts are publication-grade Active users / Top pages / Deploys cards; backs carry the same topic tag, a 104px number and a 32px outcome label that trails the number by 4f and rises 10px into place

During the flip the card lifts 5% on a sin envelope; a floor shadow outside the 3D transform tracks the projected width |cos θ|, its contact layer fading and ambient layer growing softer and dropping 34px as the card rises
Back face uses a hairline border, top inner highlight and a faint white gradient, with the system font stack and tabular numerals
